'''2000 UK National Championship''' was the United Kingdom's Star Wars CCG national championship of 2000. [[Gary Carman]] won it.<ref name="carman">Gary Carman's decks: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010227193213/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/ls119.htm ls119.htm], [[Trandosite]]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20040718041904/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/ds116.htm ds116.htm], [[Trandosite]]</ref>

* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Date:''' 2 April 2000<ref name="tr-d442" />
* '''Site:''' Warwick, England<ref name="tr-d442" />
* '''Players:''' 40<ref name="tr-d733" />

== Trandosite decklists ==

Trandosite also published Marcus Wood's decks "used at the UK National Championships". They were captured in October 2000 with Enhanced Jabba's Palace as their latest expansion, the same period as Gary Carman's winning lists, so they are from the 2000 event.<ref name="ls115">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/ls115.htm Who Said Artoo Wasn't Key?], [[Trandosite]]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010112054000/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/ls115.htm Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="ds112">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/ds112.htm This Deal Just Gets Worse], [[Trandosite]]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20020727095624/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/ds112.htm Internet Archive]</ref>
